caption: The video showcases a wide autumn mountain vista in a nearly static composition. A steep gray rock cliff capped with dark evergreens rises along the right side, while a broad slope in the center and foreground glows with red, orange, and yellow fall foliage. To the left, a hazy blue mountain range recedes into the distance, its near hillside marked by a large triangular shadow. A pale sky streaked with thin, wispy clouds fills the upper portion, and a dark green tree silhouette anchors the bottom-right corner. Throughout, the scene appears to drift only very slowly and subtly sideways, with little visible independent movement among leaves, branches, or clouds. Lighting and color remain broadly constant as the gentle lateral shift continues across the landscape.
relations: The steep gray cliff on the right remains fixed relative to the foliage slope as the view drifts sideways.
The hazy blue mountains on the left shift slowly with the lateral drift, preserving their triangular shadow.
The pale sky and wispy clouds move subtly in the same direction as the foreground tree silhouette.
Lighting and color stay constant across the landscape during the gentle horizontal shift.
